name: sc-major-celltype-annotation-auto
description: Approved multi-tissue major-celltype annotation with shared cross-account case learning, staged knowledge promotion, deterministic QA, and delivery.

interface.displayName: 03 · 单细胞大类注释（主要谱系）
interface.shortDescription: 跨全细胞或混合谱系自动完成大类注释、审计与原目录交付
interface.longDescription: 从平均表达表与 Marker Excel 或 Seurat 对象开始，静默推断可确定的元数据与路径，按统一大类层级完成证据优先注释；经确定性 QA 后自动将唯一最终工作簿交付到原始 E 盘输入目录。
capabilities: Minimal ratio-enhanced and cell-validated evidence modes
Versioned shared evidence core with SHA-256 snapshot checks
Major-depth subtype projection before rival-lineage review
R0-R3 conservative contamination and doublet actions
XLSX TSV and CSV average-expression inputs
Independent per-cluster T/NK arbitration with mixed/doublet merge blocking
State and subtype separation from major identity
Automatic final-workbook delivery with SHA-256 verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $sc-major-celltype-annotation-auto to annotate mixed lineages with the approved multi-tissue ontology, tissue modules, per-cluster T/NK decisions, and one validated workbook.
